regime.summary: Market tide net-positive into the open but concentrated in two semis names rather than broad. VIX term structure in mild contango, so premium is not cheap. CPI at 08:30 already cleared without a surprise, which removes the main scheduled risk but also the main catalyst. Treating this as a stock-picker's tape, not an index tape.
regime.regime_invalidation: SPY loses 640.50 on volume above the 20-day average pace, or VIX prints above 17.5. Either means the two-sided read is wrong and this is a directional risk-off day.

names.thesis: Third consecutive session of ask-side call accumulation in the same weekly strike while the stock has gone nowhere — flow is leading price, not confirming it.

flow.detail: Same 142 strike accumulating Tue/Wed/Thu. OI up 31% over the three sessions while the underlying is net -0.4%. Sweeps, not blocks — somebody is paying up rather than working an order.

evidence.macro: Semis were the one sector the brief flagged as carrying real net premium today, so this runs with the tape rather than against it.
evidence.technical: Coiled under 138.50, which has capped it four times since July 29.
evidence.positioning: Max pain at 136 with the gamma flip just below at 135.20 — dealers are short gamma above 139, which would accelerate a break rather than dampen it.

iv_context.note: IV rank in the lower third, so we are buying reasonably priced premium rather than paying up into an event. Debit spread still preferred over a naked long to cut theta.

catalyst.note: Earnings not until Sept 24 — this is not an earnings positioning trade.

names.structure_hint: Debit call spread, 5-7 DTE, 140/145. Do not chase above 140 — the risk/reward is built on entering near the breakout, not after it.

triggers.note: MU broke the level that has capped it four times since late July. This is the entry the thesis was built around.
MU below 135.10 — the accumulation thesis is wrong. Stand down for the session.
Put premium building against the call accumulation. Whoever was buying may be hedging or unwinding.

names.thesis: Dark pool accumulation under 92 for four sessions with no matching options flow — interesting, but not yet a trade.

flow.detail: Repeated large prints between 91.40 and 91.90. No corroborating options flow, which is why this is watch_only rather than actionable.

evidence.macro: Energy was neutral in the sector tide — no tailwind here.

iv_context.note: IV is cheap but there is no catalyst to make it expand.

triggers.note: Options flow finally confirming the dark pool accumulation in XLE. This is what would turn it into a trade.

names.thesis: Carrier for the regime-break trigger. Not a trade in itself.

evidence.macro: The brief's invalidation is expressed on SPY, so it needs to be on the monitored list for the trigger to be evaluated at all.

triggers.note: The day's two-sided read is broken — SPY lost 640.50. Every name on the list is now suspect and long-call exposure should be reassessed.
